en.answer: When resolving the effect of <<13504>> that adds a monster to your hand, you can choose monsters other than Pendulum Monsters.
en.question: If a monster that <<13504>> points to that was Special Summoned from the Extra Deck is destroyed by battle or by opponent's card effect, can I activate the effect of <<13504>> and choose a non-Pendulum Monster in my Graveyard?
